title: Kylo Ren
subtitle: The First Order
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: Obsessed with discovering the truth of Palpatine's return, Kylo Ren sought a Sith Wayfinder on Mustafar and used it to confront the Sith Eternal on Exegol in a bid to seek a way to control the galaxy. But after his mother's sacrifice, Kylo Ren found himself turned back to the light and fought alongside Rey to destroy the Sith and their corrupting influence once and for all.
